note: On the north arm of Green Mountain Reservoir at ~7,950 ft, off Heeney Road (County Road 30) just west of CO-9, between Silverthorne and Kremmling. Sites line the shore along a dirt loop; the reservoir is drawn down through late summer. Recreation.gov: site access is difficult when the road is wet. Motorboats launch only from Heeney Marina after an Aquatic Nuisance Species inspection. --Claude

Against that, recreation.gov's catalog shows 21 sites, almost all 'Parallel' roadside pull-outs with driveway lengths 30-93 ft (only site 011, a 25-ft pull-through, carries a Max Vehicle Length), and on NAIP the sites are open gravel pull-outs along the loop road with no trees boxing them in. The 20 ft looks like a table default (Prairie Point gets the same) but it is the agency's own figure; recorded as max_rig_ft 20. AWH to decide keep/drop.

Pin 39.88944,-106.30833 sits between sites 6 and 7 at the south end of the shoreline row, 182 m from the site centroid. OK.

Waterfront (stored lakefront) - confirmed at full pool, with a caveat: sites 1-12 sit along the top of the reservoir's bathtub ring with an open, treeless apron to the water and sites 16-21 line the north arm. On this NAIP frame (autumn drawdown) open water is ~100-150 m out across bare lakebed and the north arm is dry. Lakefront holds at high water (early-mid summer); late-season visitors will find mudflat. The White River alerts page (read 2026-10-28) says 'The boat ramp at Green Mountain Reservoir is closed for the 2026 season for public safety due to low water' - so in a dry year the drawdown starts early.
